steps.title: Collect rat blood samples
steps.instruction: Collect whole blood from pregnant rats at term by tail cut: 5.0–9.0 mL into dry tubes (no anticoagulant) and 1.5 mL into tubes containing 0.2 mL heparin; keep at 4–8 °C for 30 min (do NOT place on wet ice).

steps.title: Obtain washed erythrocytes
steps.instruction: Centrifuge heparinized tubes at 185 × g for 10 min at 4 °C; discard plasma and buffy coat. If separation fails, repeat centrifugation once; if still fails, discard sample.

steps.title: Wash erythrocytes three times
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL PBS 1× (pH 7.4) to the erythrocyte pellet, centrifuge at 1,575 × g for 1 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant; repeat the wash (add PBS, centrifuge) three total times.

steps.title: Aliquot erythrocytes for Hb/TBARS/SH
steps.instruction: Label three 1.5 mL microtubes (Hb, TBARS, SH). Pipette 50 µL washed erythrocyte pellet into each tube, add 950 µL purified water, invert gently to homogenize, and store at –80 °C (stable ≤6 months).

steps.title: Aliquot erythrocytes for activity assays
steps.instruction: Label five 1.5 mL microtubes (Hb, SOD, H₂O₂, GSH‑Px, CAT). Pipette 50 µL washed erythrocyte pellet into each tube, add 950 µL stabilizing solution (2.7 mM EDTA + 0.7 mM 2‑mercaptoethanol), invert gently, and store at –80 °C (stable ≤6 months).

steps.title: Collect serum from dry tubes
steps.instruction: Centrifuge dry‑tube blood at 1,575 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, collect supernatant serum with a micropipette, discard the cell pellet, and keep serum on ice.

steps.title: Aliquot serum for assays
steps.instruction: Dispense serum into six labeled 1.5 mL microtubes: 20 µL for protein, 550 µL for TBARS, 10 µL for SH, 20 µL for H₂O₂, 5 µL for SOD, 5 µL for GSH‑Px. Store at –80 °C (stable ≤6 months).

steps.title: Prepare stabilizing solution (Recipe 1)
steps.instruction: Mix 10 mL purified water with 0.5 µL 2‑mercaptoethanol; add 2.7 mM EDTA (final concentration). Store 2–8 °C, stable ≤6 months.

steps.title: Prepare Drabkin’s solution (Recipe 2)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 200 mg potassium ferricyanide, 50 mg potassium cyanide, and 1 g NaHCO₃ in 1 000 mL purified water; protect from light, store at 4 °C in amber bottle, stable ≤6 months.

steps.title: Prepare 1 µg/µL BSA stock (Recipe 3)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g BSA in 1 mL purified water; store 2–8 °C, stable ≤6 months.

steps.title: Prepare 3 % 5‑sulfosalicylic acid (Recipe 4)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 3 g sulfosalicylic acid in 100 mL ultrapure water in a volumetric flask; seal with laboratory film, keep at 25 °C, prepare fresh for each assay day; discard after use.

steps.title: Prepare TBA solution 0.67 % (Recipe 5)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.67 g TBA in 95 mL purified water, heat to 80 °C for 30 min, cool to 25 °C, adjust pH to 2.0 with 1 M NaOH, bring to 100 mL with water, store in amber bottle partially sealed, keep at 25 °C, prepare fresh on assay day; discard after use.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M HCl (Recipe 6)
steps.instruction: Dilute 8.3 mL concentrated HCl in 100 mL purified water; store 2–8 °C, stability unspecified.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 M TRIS/HCl 0.5 mM EDTA pH 8.0 (Recipe 7)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.2114 g TRIS‑Ultrapure™ and 0.0146 g EDTA in 90 mL purified water, adjust pH to 8.0 with 1 M HCl, bring to 100 mL with water; store 2–8 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 10 mM DTNB (Recipe 8)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.0079 g DTNB in 2 mL ethyl alcohol, aliquot into two 1 mL microtubes, seal and store at –20 °C; prepare fresh, discard remaining solution.

steps.title: Prepare Solution 1 (buffer A)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 8 g NaCl, 0.2 g KCl, 0.2 g K₂HPO₄, 1.15 g Na₂HPO₄ in a volumetric flask, add 80 mL purified water, seal with film, keep at 25 °C; after making Buffer B store at 2–8 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Solution 2 (90 mM CaCl₂)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.3 g CaCl₂ in 30 mL purified water, homogenize, seal with film, keep at 25 °C; after Buffer B preparation store at 2–8 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Solution 3 (0.11 M MgCl₂)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.3 g MgCl₂ in 30 mL purified water, homogenize, seal with film, keep at 25 °C; after Buffer B preparation store at 2–8 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Solution 4 (0.1 % phenol red)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.3 g phenol red in 30 mL purified water, heat to 54 °C until fully dissolved, cool, seal with film, keep at 25 °C; after Buffer B preparation store at 25 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Phosphate buffer solution A (Recipe 13)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2.61 g K₂HPO₄ in 150 mL purified water, seal; dissolve 2.06 g KH₂PO₄ in another 150 mL purified water, seal; mix 100 mL K₂HPO₄ solution with KH₂PO₄ solution, adjust to pH 7.0, store 2–8 °C.

steps.title: Prepare peroxidase (HRP) solution (Recipe 14)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 mg HRP in 1 mL phosphate buffer solution A; prepare fresh, discard after use.

steps.title: Prepare Buffer solution B (Recipe 15)
steps.instruction: Mix 10.56 mL purified water, 0.960 mL Solution 1, 0.120 mL Solution 2, 0.120 mL Solution 3, 0.120 mL Solution 4, and 0.120 mL HRP solution; prepare fresh, discard after use.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M NaOH (Recipe 16)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.040 g NaOH in 0.10 mL purified water; store 2–8 °C, stability unspecified.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M TRIS/HCl 5 mM EDTA pH 8.0 (Recipe 17)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 6.0570 g TRIS‑Ultrapure™ and 0.0731 g EDTA in 45 mL purified water, adjust pH to 8.0 with 1 M HCl, bring to 50 mL with water; store 2–8 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 10 mM pyrogallol solution (Recipe 18)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.0063 g pyrogallol in 5 mL 10 mM HCl solution; prepare fresh, minimum 5 mL, discard after use.

steps.title: Prepare 50 mM TRIS/HCl 5 mM EDTA pH 7.6 (Recipe 19)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.6057 g TRIS‑Ultrapure™ and 0.1461 g EDTA in 90 mL purified water, adjust pH to 7.6 with 1 M HCl, bring to 100 mL with water; store 2–8 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1 % NaHCO₃ + 1 mM EDTA (Recipe 20)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g NaHCO₃ and 0.0292 g EDTA in 100 mL purified water; store 2–8 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 10 mM HCl solution (Recipe 21)
steps.instruction: Dilute 50 µL concentrated HCl in 60 mL purified water; store 2–8 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 M GSH solution (Recipe 22)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.0184 g reduced glutathione (GSH) in 600 µL 10 mM HCl solution; keep on ice, prepare fresh, discard after use.

steps.title: Prepare 10 U/mL GSH‑Rd solution (Recipe 23)
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL glutathione reductase (10 U/mL) to 2.940 mL of 0.1 M TRIS/HCl 0.5 mM EDTA pH 8.0; keep on ice, prepare fresh, discard after use.

steps.title: Prepare 7 mM t‑butyl hydroperoxide (Recipe 24)
steps.instruction: Dilute 5 µL t‑butyl hydroperoxide in 5 mL purified water; prepare fresh, discard after use.

steps.title: Prepare 4 mM NADPH solution (Recipe 25)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.010 g NADPH in 3 mL 1 % NaHCO₃ + 1 mM EDTA; keep on ice, stable ≤4 h, discard after use.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 M NaH₂PO₄·H₂O solution (Recipe 26)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2.7598 g NaH₂PO₄·H₂O in 190 mL purified water, adjust pH to 7.0 with 1 M NaOH, bring to 200 mL with water; store 2–8 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M H₂O₂ solution (Recipe 27)
steps.instruction: Add 970 µL concentrated H₂O₂ to 9.03 mL purified water; prepare fresh, discard after use.

steps.title: Quantify hemoglobin (Drabkin’s method)
steps.instruction: Take the Hb‑purified‑water and Hb‑stabilizing‑solution microtubes, vortex to homogenize. In a 96‑well plate add 200 µL Drabkin’s solution to two wells (blank). To each assay well add 197.5 µL Drabkin’s solution + 2.5 µL sample (duplicate). Mix on plate mixer 1 min at 750 rpm, rest 10 min at 25 °C, tap plate gently, read absorbance at 546 nm (Gen5). Calculate Hb concentration.

steps.title: Quantify serum protein (Bradford)
steps.instruction: Dilute serum 1:100 (1 part serum + 99 parts purified water). Prepare BSA standards 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.8, 1.0 µg/µL from 1 µg/µL stock by mixing indicated volumes (e.g., 5 µL stock + 45 µL water for 0.1 µg/µL). Dilute Bradford reagent 1:4 (10 mL concentrate + 40 mL water). Add 190 µL Bradford reagent to each well, then 10 µL BSA standard (duplicate) or 10 µL serum sample (duplicate); mix with tip, read at 595 nm (Gen5), calculate protein concentration.

steps.title: Perform TBARS assay
steps.instruction: Prepare 3 % 5‑sulfosalicylic acid and 0.67 % TBA solutions. Add 500 µL sample (serum or washed erythrocyte) to 500 µL 3 % SSA in a microtube, vortex 10 s, centrifuge 18,000 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, rest 15 min at 25 °C, transfer supernatant to a new tube (avoid brown granules). Add 500 µL TBA solution to 500 µL supernatant, vortex 10 s, heat at 95 °C for 30 min (partially sealed tubes), cool on ice 10 min. Equilibrate blanks and samples at 25 °C, pipette 300 µL purified water to two blank wells, 300 µL each sample (duplicate) to assay wells, tap plate gently, read absorbance at 535 nm (Gen5), calculate TBARS.

steps.title: Quantify reduced thiols in erythrocytes
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 0.1 M TRIS/HCl 0.5 mM EDTA pH 8.0 to two blank wells. To each sample well add 195 µL of the same buffer, 1.0 µL washed erythrocyte (duplicate), and 4.0 µL 10 mM DTNB; mix on plate mixer 10 min at 750 rpm, read at 412 nm.

steps.title: Quantify reduced thiols in serum
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 0.1 M TRIS/HCl 0.5 mM EDTA pH 8.0 to two blank wells. To each sample well add 175 µL buffer, 5.0 µL serum (duplicate), and 20 µL 10 mM DTNB; mix 10 min at 750 rpm, read at 412 nm (Gen5), calculate –SH concentration.

steps.title: Measure H₂O₂ in erythrocytes
steps.instruction: Add 110 µL Buffer B to two blank wells. To each sample well add 5 µL washed erythrocyte (duplicate) and 105 µL Buffer B; mix 10 s at 750 rpm, incubate 37 °C 10 min, add 10 µL 1 M NaOH to stop, read at 620 nm (Gen5), calculate H₂O₂.

steps.title: Measure H₂O₂ in serum
steps.instruction: Add 110 µL Buffer B to two blank wells. To each sample well add 10 µL serum (duplicate) and 100 µL Buffer B; mix 10 s at 750 rpm, incubate 37 °C 10 min, add 10 µL 1 M NaOH, read at 620 nm (Gen5), calculate H₂O₂.

steps.title: Assay superoxide dismutase (SOD)
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 M TRIS/HCl 5 mM EDTA pH 8.0 and 10 mM pyrogallol solutions. Add 147 µL buffer to two blank wells. To each sample well add 144 µL buffer, 3.0 µL washed erythrocyte or serum (duplicate), then 3.0 µL 10 mM pyrogallol to all wells (including blanks). Tap plate gently, measure absorbance at 420 nm at 0 min (T0) and 10 min (T10) at 25 °C, calculate SOD activity (Gen5).

steps.title: Assay glutathione peroxidase (GSH‑Px)
steps.instruction: Keep all solutions on ice. Prepare MIX solution immediately before assay: 240 µL 0.1 M GSH, 1 200 µL 10 U/mL GSH‑Rd, 1 200 µL 4 mM NADPH (keep on ice). Add 100 µL 50 mM TRIS/HCl 5 mM EDTA pH 7.6 to each well, then 1.0 µL serum or 0.5 µL washed erythrocyte (duplicate), tap, add 50 µL MIX, tap, add 20 µL 7 mM t‑butyl hydroperoxide to start reaction, quickly homogenize. Measure absorbance every minute for 5 min at 25 °C, 340 nm (Gen5), calculate GSH‑Px activity.

steps.title: Assay catalase (CAT)
steps.instruction: Verify H₂O₂ concentration: add 1 000 µL 0.1 M NaH₂PO₄·H₂O to cuvette 1 (blank) and 990 µL same buffer to cuvette 2, AUTO‑ZERO UV1800, add 10 µL 1 M H₂O₂ to cuvette 2, homogenize, read at 240 nm to calculate real H₂O₂ molarity. Wash cuvettes. For assay, add 999 µL 0.1 M NaH₂PO₄·H₂O + 1 µL washed erythrocytes to cuvette 1 (blank) and 978 µL buffer + 1 µL erythrocytes to cuvette 2 (reading). AUTO‑ZERO, add 21 µL 1 M H₂O₂ to cuvette 2, homogenize, record kinetics for 2 min at 25 °C at 240 nm (UVProbe), calculate CAT activity.
